title: Your Professor's AI Policy Is a Lie: How to Use AI Without Getting Caught
description: Your school's AI policy protects itself, not you. Employers in 2026 expect AI fluency as a default job skill. Use AI as a thinking partner — never a ghostwriter — and learn to document your process so you can defend every word.
author: Jake Morrison

title: The Student AI Stack: 7 Free Tools That Save 10 Hours a Week
description: Most students are running 8-15 different apps for school. You only need 7, all free, and they integrate into a single pipeline that cuts your weekly study time by 30-40%.
author: Maya Chen

title: The $600/Mo Side Hustle: Selling Digital Products as a Student
description: Sell digital products (study guides, templates, Notion dashboards) on Gumroad or Etsy. Create once, earn $200-$2,000/month passively. No inventory, no shipping, no customer service after setup.
author: Ravi Patel

title: From Lecture to A-Grade: The Complete AI Note-Taking Pipeline
description: Record lectures with Otter.ai, upload to NotebookLM, generate study guides and practice questions, write your essay using Claude, and finalize with Grammarly. Total active time per lecture: 20 minutes.
author: Maya Chen

title: How I Automated My Job Applications and Landed 3 Internships
description: Use AI to tailor every application to the specific role, track your pipeline automatically, and practice interviews with voice-based AI. I sent 47 applications, got 12 interviews, and received 3 offers.
author: Lena Okafor

title: Research Like a PhD: Primary Sources, Academic Databases & AI
description: Stop relying on Google Scholar alone. How to find real primary sources, use academic databases effectively, and leverage AI without crossing ethical lines.
author: Dr. Aris Vane
